name: nsplanner
description: Smarter NS route planner — monorepo (planner, API, web, CLI, MCP)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nsplanner/planner && npm run build -w @nsplanner/api && npm run build -w @nsplanner/web && npm run build -w @nsplanner/cli && npm run build -w @nsplanner/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nsplanner/planner && npm run typecheck -w @nsplanner/api && npm run typecheck -w @nsplanner/cli && npm run typecheck -w @nsplanner/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @nsplanner/web
